## Plan (Phase 1)

1. **Stand-in capture model.** A shared `_fixture_commit(path)` helper reads
   each fixture's real authoring time from `git log -1 --format=%h %cI`
   (never typed). The three packet builders stamp the connector replay's
   `retrieved_at` with the fixture's commit time; every emitted record is
   stamped `capture_kind: "fixture_replay"`; every packet-authored record
   (shadow `_fixture_artifact`, `_pack_claim`, `_operator_claim`, `_authored`)
   carries `capture_kind: "stand-in"`, NO `retrieved_date`/`retrieved_at`,
   and `committed_at`/`fixture_commit` provenance. Each packet declares a
   `capture` block `{kind: "fixture_replay", live_verification: false,
   anchor: <newest fixture commit>, fixtures: {document_id → {path, commit,
   committed_at}}}`; `as_of`/`searched_at`/`generated_at` default to the
   anchor; OKC's "announced vs operative" day becomes an explicit
   `scenario_as_of` (derived: stated retention `valid_from` + 1 day), never a
   capture date.
2. **Refusals.** `build_packet(*, retrieved_at, as_of, build_time)` refuses a
   `retrieved_at` after any fixture's commit and an `as_of` after the build
   time (ValueError). `_MapTransport` carries per-URL commit times and
   refuses an override beyond them.
3. **Shared validator.** `exports.research_dossier` gains
   `capture_chronology_violations(packet, now=…)`: for packets declaring
   `capture.fixtures`, every record's `retrieved_at`/`retrieved_date`/
   `observed_at`/`searched_at` (incl. `evidence.*`) must be ≤ its fixture's
   declared `committed_at`; a `capture_kind: stand-in` record may carry NO
   retrieval date; `as_of` must not exceed the build time; `searched_at` ≤
   anchor. `validate_packet` calls it (fail-closed at composition).
   `build_dossier`/`_assertion`/`_ledger_row`/print HTML pass `capture_kind`
   through so rendered dates are labelled honestly.
4. **Web.** `research-dossier.ts` gains optional `capture_kind`/`capture`;
   the fixture becomes `capture_kind: "stand-in"` with NO `retrieved_date`,
   `as_of`/`searched_at` = its real authoring commit (`df8c5ab1`,
   2026-09-27); the page renders the stand-in posture in place of a
   fabricated retrieval date; the no-JS spec asserts the stand-in label.
5. **Registry corrections (additive).** `sources.toml` gains
   `[[sources.<id>.date_corrections]]` for the 21 misdated lines (15 fields +
   6 `FLIPPED` notes): `{field, recorded, true = 2026-09-13, evidence =
   "e1cedcad", adr = "ADR-146"}`. `registry.SourceRecord` gains
   `date_corrections` + `effective_date(field)`; `connectors.corrections`
   echoes them onto each artifact row; `db.rights_corrections` ignores them
   (back-compat). The recorded values are byte-identical (ADR-146 D2).
6. **Regeneration.** The four committed fixture-run outputs are re-emitted by
   the fixed code into `*-YYYY-MM-DD` sibling dirs (`date -u`); the originals
   keep their bytes (sha256 recorded in the successor's manifest); each
   `CORRECTION.md` gains an appended supersession pointer.
7. **Policy/tests.** `history.policy`: the P34.22a first-run comment naming
   P34.22b is corrected (the four captured-JSON allow entries cover
   real-world fixture literals that remain — they stay). The 23 date pins in
   tests become invariants derived from `git log` / builder inputs. R4 packet
   check beside `test_no_future_date_literals.py`.
8. **Correction lines** appended to the five provenance/comment records
   (2× SOURCES.md headings, 3× test comments) — original text kept.
